reimagine-dumbarton-busway.name: Dumbarton rail corridor, Middlefield Rd to University Ave
reimagine-dumbarton-busway.method: The Dumbarton rail right-of-way (the past era's Dumbarton Cutoff, from OpenHistoricalMap's ways) between where today's Middlefield Rd and University Ave cross it (Overture centerlines): the busway runs on the rail corridor "between Middlefield Road (Redwood City) and University Avenue (East Palo Alto)" (paraphrase). Not drawn: its two links to Redwood City Transit Center, by Woodside Rd and El Camino Real, and by Middlefield Rd and Jefferson Ave.

sources.note: A dedicated busway and a parallel trail on the rail corridor between Middlefield Road and University Avenue, with nine stations: "Fair Oaks Health Center/Middlefield Road, Fifth Avenue, Ninth Avenue, Bay Road/Marsh Road, Bohannon Drive, Belle Haven Community Campus, Chilco Street, Willow Road, and University Avenue".
